title: First-install publisher trust is still candidate-controlled
recommendation: Use an OS-enforced signed MSIX/App Installer publisher identity or mandatory WDAC/AppLocker/Smart App Control policy before first execution; retain candidate self-checks only as defense in depth and independently authenticate any classic-Setup verifier.

title: Threshold finalization accepts public roots supplied by signer artifacts
recommendation: Pin enrolled signer public keys in an independently administered finalizer/HSM/KMS policy, carry signatures rather than roots in response artifacts, threshold-authorize key rotation, and condition publisher signing on an externally verified threshold receipt.

title: Portable upgrades do not enforce an authenticated rollback floor
recommendation: Validate authorization signatures and numeric release sequence against installed pinned roots and a transactional protected highest-installed floor before mutation; align ZIP and Setup policy and use an external/TPM floor where whole-host rollback is in scope.

title: SSH live ingestion lacks authenticated producer provenance
recommendation: Require broker-assigned producer identity plus a fixed producer/schema allowlist for live SSH evidence, and prevent unprovenanced EventBus text from advancing the trusted known-source baseline.

title: Trusted-time receipt flooring is consumed twice across client and appraisal
recommendation: Advance each receipt exactly once and pass a typed durable-verification result into appraisal, or use explicitly separate named floor domains; add a real production client-to-appraisal composition regression.

title: A closed Sentinel authority remains able to process state transactions
recommendation: Make close irreversible, require a live held lease for every state transaction, stop and join request/handshake workers before lease release, and add close/reopen concurrency regressions.

title: Linux removable-device inventory can report complete absence with unreadable entries
recommendation: Report absence only when every enumerated entry yields a stable valid zero; mark mixed valid/unknown reads incomplete while preserving positive presence, and add mixed-read and disappearing-entry tests.
